svg.title: Selank: from memory stimulant to anxiolytic
svg.desc: 1983: USSR patent 1124544 (cited later): TKPRPGP as a memory stimulant; 1995: 'TP-7' (tuftsin analog) anxiolytic in rats, 95 animals; 1999: RU 2155065: 'Selank' nasal drops as an anxiolytic (animal examples); 2008: Selank vs medazepam, 62 patients (GAD, neurasthenia); 2009: Russian registration ЛСР-003338/09; 2011: Dissertation: only 'partial' effect in phobic/hypochondriac anxiety; 2014: Selank vs phenazepam, 60 patients, open-label, Peptogen-funded; 2025: Re-registered ЛП-№(010951)-(РГ-RU), non-prescription

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
